why: A static page has no Tailwind utilities, so the seven-rung type ladder, base rules and faces ship as plain CSS, and the pre-paint script and setScheme must agree on every stored-value case (shutterflow cookie, legacy mantine key).
what: Template source packages/basalt-ui/src/css/templates/{typography,fonts}.css (new), their generated outputs src/css/{typography,fonts}.css, and the scheme-parity cases. src/css/generate.ts (tok-t3) stays the only writer of the five CSS files and reads each template after the emitted vars; one allowed edit there: add the read of YOUR two templates if absent. themeScript and setScheme are tok-t3's (src/core/scheme*).
contract: docs/v3/concepts/static-framework-free.md section 4.1 (entries), section 8 P8 and P9 inputs, section 10 amendment A3; docs/v3/concepts/tokens-visual.md sections 3.7 and 4.
exemplar: packages/basalt-ui/src/tokens/build-fonts-css.test.ts (2.x fonts emit test) and src/vite-boot.ts (2.x boot script).
change: templates/typography.css: @layer basalt.type, text vars and :where(:root) base only plus the reduced-motion reset, no class selector. templates/fonts.css: @font-face only for @fontsource-variable/{nunito-sans,hubot-sans,jetbrains-mono}, unused weights not imported. Then run bun packages/basalt-ui/src/css/generate.ts and commit the regenerated outputs (never hand-edit them). Parity: test/fixtures/scheme-parity/cases.json is one table (stored value, cookie, legacy mantine-color-scheme-value, OS preference, default, expected data-theme); tests/scheme-parity.test.ts (fast loop, happy-dom) runs it against BOTH themeScript() and setScheme() so they cannot diverge; cases include cookie sf-color-scheme=dark with empty storage, throwing storage, auto meaning attribute absent, late setScheme re-stamp. Rule: none. Skill snippet: none.
commits: One PR, separate package and non-package commits (isolated-basalt-ui); conventional, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: Fast-loop parity tests; browser P8 and P9 are v3-st-7's.
acceptance: bun test packages/basalt-ui/tests/scheme-parity.test.ts passes: both implementations produce the same data-theme for every case
bun test packages/basalt-ui/src/css passes (committed typography.css and fonts.css equal the generated output)
typography.css contains no class selector and no !important outside the reduced-motion block (tests/typography.test.ts)
Every rung's size and line height in typography.css equals the token table's value (test)
out_of_scope: themeScript and setScheme implementation, prose.css, any Tailwind file, docs/static-site.md.
test_layout: Runners in packages/basalt-ui/tests/**; fixture data in test/fixtures/**, which v3-test-roots hides from root lint, fmt and bun test. Add no ignore lines.
